query:
SELECT
            users.id,
            users.name,
            users.discord_id,
            users.cash_balance as "cash_balance: Currency",
            source as "source: TransferSource",
            SUM(net_amount) AS "net: Currency"
        FROM (
            SELECT
                receiver AS user_id,
                source,
                amount AS net_amount
            FROM transfers
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                sender AS user_id,
                source,
                -amount AS net_amount
            FROM transfers
        ) t
        JOIN users ON users.id = user_id
        GROUP BY user_id, source
